source.reviewScope: Original ordinary teaching content; source meaning/POS and every question checked against the text; not calibrated IELTS assessment.

questions.prompt: Why does Maya use old paper for her first sketch?
answers: To change ideas before using expensive paper.
questions.evidence: Maya makes a quick sketch on old paper first. This lets the group change an idea before using expensive paper.
questions.explanation: This 指先在旧纸上画草图的做法，其目的是先调整想法再用贵的纸。不是为了让颜料更快干。
options: To make the paint dry faster.
To avoid following the design.
To finish the final picture without paint.
To change ideas before using expensive paper.

questions.prompt: How many brushes are available? Write ONE WORD from the passage.
questions.evidence: There are four brushes for six people, so they cannot all paint at once.
questions.explanation: four 是画笔数量，six 是人数。本题只写画笔的数量。

questions.prompt: Why must the learners share brushes?
answers: There are fewer brushes than learners.
questions.evidence: There are four brushes for six people, so they cannot all paint at once.
questions.explanation: 六个人只有四支画笔，工具数量少于人数。不能因为看见四和六，就误选工具比人多。
options: The brushes are all broken.
There are more brushes than learners.
There are fewer brushes than learners.
Only one learner wants to paint.

questions.prompt: Which color of paint is not available? Write ONE WORD from the passage.
questions.evidence: There is some blue and green paint, but there is no red paint.
questions.explanation: no red paint 说明没有红颜料。blue 和 green 都是已有的颜色，but 标出区别。

questions.prompt: What must learners do before touching the materials?
answers: Read the steps on the wall.
questions.evidence: Mr. Lee asks the learners to read the steps before touching anything.
questions.explanation: before 表明先读步骤，再碰材料。课后解释难点是另一项最后才做的活动。
options: Put the final picture on the wall.
Explain the most difficult step.
Read the steps on the wall.
Show their work to another group.

questions.prompt: Which shape goes at the bottom? Write ONE WORD from the passage.
questions.evidence: A square goes near the top, and a triangle goes at the bottom.
questions.explanation: bottom 对应 triangle；square 在靠近顶部的位置。两者不能互换。

questions.prompt: How much space does Maya leave around the picture? Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS from the passage.
questions.evidence: She leaves two centimeters between the picture and the edge of the paper.
questions.explanation: two centimeters 表示两厘米的间距。保留 centimeters 复数；只写 two 缺少距离单位。

questions.prompt: Why do the learners arrange the shapes before attaching them?
answers: They may want to change the positions.
questions.evidence: They do not attach them immediately, because they may want to move them.
questions.explanation: because 后解释先摆放而不立即贴上的原因：还可能移动图形。不是没有任何纸，也不是禁止使用形状。
options: They may want to change the positions.
They are not allowed to use shapes.
They have already painted the wall.
They do not have any paper.

questions.prompt: After how long do the learners change jobs? Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS from the passage.
questions.evidence: After fifteen minutes, they change jobs.
questions.explanation: fifteen minutes 是换工作的间隔；ninety minutes 是整个项目的可用时间。

questions.prompt: What can a learner do after making a small mistake?
questions.evidence: A small mistake can be corrected with a spare piece of paper, so nobody needs to start again.
questions.explanation: 原文说可用备用纸修正，因此不必全部重做。so 后说明这个办法的结果。
options: Start the whole picture again.
Stop taking part in the project.
Throw away every tool.
Correct it with spare paper.

questions.prompt: Why is the finished picture not moved at ten twenty?
questions.evidence: At ten twenty, the picture is finished, but the paint is not dry.
questions.explanation: finished 指制作完成；not dry 表示颜料未干，制作完成不等于可以立即搬动。
options: The design is still missing.
The paint is still wet.
Mr. Lee has not arrived.
The learners have no tools.

questions.prompt: What do the learners do while waiting to move the picture?
answers: Put away tools and check for paint on the floor.
questions.evidence: While they wait, the group puts the tools away and checks the floor for drops of paint.
questions.explanation: while 表示等候期间同时做整理工作。换设计、借更多画笔和重新画不是这段的安排。
options: Change all three shapes in the design.
Begin the whole picture again.
Put away tools and check for paint on the floor.
Borrow more brushes from another group.

title: A Shared Studio Project
passage:
On Wednesday, Maya and Leo join four other learners in a school art studio. Their project is a welcome picture for a community room. They have ninety minutes. Before they start, Mr. Lee shows them a simple design. Maya makes a quick sketch on old paper first. This lets the group change an idea before using expensive paper.

There are four brushes for six people, so they cannot all paint at once. Each brush is clean and ready. There is some blue and green paint, but there is no red paint. Paper is the main material for the project. A ruler is another useful tool. Each instruction on the wall describes one step. Mr. Lee asks the learners to read the steps before touching anything.

The group chooses a pattern with three different shapes. A circle goes in the middle. A square goes near the top, and a triangle goes at the bottom. Each shape has a different size. Maya checks one small detail: there must be space around every shape. She leaves two centimeters between the picture and the edge of the paper. Leo cleans the table because they need a smooth surface to work on.

The learners arrange the shapes before adding paint. They do not attach them immediately, because they may want to move them. Maya asks to borrow a ruler from the next table. She promises to return it before the lesson ends. The group decides to share the brushes: three people work while the others prepare paper. After fifteen minutes, they change jobs. Everyone must be careful with the wet picture. A small mistake can be corrected with a spare piece of paper, so nobody needs to start again.

At ten twenty, the picture is finished, but the paint is not dry. Mr. Lee explains that they must wait before putting it on the wall. While they wait, the group puts the tools away and checks the floor for drops of paint. At ten forty, the picture is ready to move. Leo takes it to the community room with Maya. They show the other learners what they made and explain which step was the most difficult. The group agrees that sharing tools and checking each step helped them finish on time.
instructions: Read the whole passage. Choose ONE answer for each multiple-choice question. For short answers, use words from the passage and follow the word limit.
